notes.title: oath: there is a you that remains
notes.content:
oath: there is a you that remains


On the 27th of June, my brand new album, there is a you that remains is releasing! It's a 9 track long project with some of my best work, that I hope you enjoy! And alongside that, a companion work, a free DLC expansion will be releasing for oath!



With my previous project, my EP called oath, I released this video game alongside it - originally meant to just be a bespoke music player for the EP, it evolved into a complete game - and in the following months leading to December of last year, I kept expanding on the game until it just got bigger and bigger....



The base game and story of oath is complete - playing through the story mode + the 'home' mode to completion is the narrative and story I wanted to tell with the project. Paired with the EP itself, the 3 or so endings, secrets and world to discover in oath are done and all there for you to find!

Since the final update, I moved onto my next project, my currently upcoming album, and thought about ways I could make the rollout anything to the level I did for oath - I didn't really want to release a new completely separate video game or anything, but I still wanted something fun...



So, I ended up working on an expansion for oath! This expansion I've been working on alongside my album for the last however many months, and it'll be out on the same day - June 27th - as a companion piece to that body of work!!


What is there is a you that remains?
So, what does this expansion add?

Well - the main thing is the brand new button on the main menu - anew.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/ea90bcf5c15284e3411b5d66842a450442be0de4.png"]

Clicking that at any time will shoot you straight into the bulk of the new content - a completely new narrative and world to explore that ties into the story of my album, there is a you that remains! 

You can play this story at any time, and it's completely unrelated to the main game / oath's story as well! But- I'll discuss the new mode in a little bit - first, I'll go over some of the other changes made to the game that come alongside the DLC.



New GUI, QoL and other changes!!

You might've noticed that the title screen looks... completely different now! It's been redesigned, alongside all of the GUI to fit with the new project. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/39b7baa311134fb67c3ddd71f55d74256b262791.png"]

Things such as the EP player have been overhauled especially (now called music player, which has been reflected in a recent-ish main game update!), and now also includes all the songs from the new album as well!

Installing the DLC content will replace your old title screen and GUI with the new album-related look. The progress indicators / changing main menu / current character icon does still stay though! If you prefer the look of the old menu, it's still available if you don't install the DLC.



Being said...

The DLC is now considered the "Full Version" of the game!
All future bugpatches / adjustments and any base game QoL features have and will be worked specifically into the DLC package - it's free to download, and in my eyes replaces your current version as the main way to play/experience the game! Upkeeping both base and DLC builds just gets way too messy, so my focus is entirely on improvements to the 'full' version, with DLC enabled.

You will also need to install the DLC to 100% the game, as unfortunately you cannot designate DLC-specific achievements, so the 20ish or so new achievements do require DLC installation as well.

QoL features?

I've been listening! Some of these features are already implemented into the base game - the bulk of the game now being much more easy to unlock, the base main menu music not being so... loud, and plenty of small tweaks and fixes. Over the development of the DLC I've watched many people play the game live, and taken notes on some things to change.

 For example:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/5aee7184d9ac31eecccc35d93ec03fe9e22dce09.png"]

Right at the start of the game, new players were getting confused on who was talking - the mysterious figure in front of you or the narration/you - mostly due to the textbox being the exact same. A small but important change here is the other person now has a new textbox seen above that makes it much clearer to tell apart your dialogue from theirs! 
This is a relatively minor change, but there's plenty like it that have been added in the DLC - including better interaction detection for many, many areas (reading a sign next to a door will hopefully not make you walk inside, but actually read the sign for example), as well as bugfixes, spelling error fixing and just some more polish even to areas which were fine before, but are now slightly nicer.

Installing the DLC will retroactively add all these additions to the base game, just like a regular update/patch would! This does also mean however, if you do uninstall the DLC the game will revert back to v4.18 - the final version prior to the DLC's development.
The new expansion...
So... what's in the anew mode?

As mentioned, the DLC adds a brand new story to the game - with a new main character and world to explore.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/f1d3cbf91cfc88a77717ae12f180bbf8d4f14f3d.png"]

This new map is 4 times the size of the base games map when it launched - combining all the new areas added with updates, the new world is still bigger than all of them plus more! It's more interconnected than ever, with dynamic music between areas, and a ton more characters that roam all around the world that you can talk to. The map above is only a snippet of the full thing!

There's a myriad of improvements in interaction compared to the base game too:

almost all non-important characters in the game have variable dialogue, being able to say more than just one thing - they've got a bunch they can tell you about that they can choose between saying, and might say different things depending on what you've done or what you're carrying.

a good majority of these characters walk around - not only outside this time, but inside too! The hitboxes for moving characters are also improved since their original inclusion, allowing you to walk past them much, much easier.

Basically everything is interactable - like, everything. Try it: interact with every single bush in the overworld. Every seashell and every tree. The base game of oath had a ton for you to interact with and discover, but the expansion pushes that even further with much, much more to see and find. On top of that, every single building's interactable objects (which is, 99% of the things inside a building) have unique dialogue specific to that one building. If you're the type of person who likes finding out every small detail or just learning more about a world, there's plenty for you here.
..Graphical improvements?
While the expansion is still generally in the same art style - it is DLC after all! - I've tried my best to both give the new areas and world a unique look while still feeling at home in oath, as well as graphically improve places where I could too!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/b98ffdc3fb045128c3b26a57f47b5fd0f9433e1e.png"]

All interiors for buildings and elsewhere have lighting! unlike how the base game was completely static in terms of light and shadow, every single interior in the expansion has deep shadows and rays of light that both are there to improve the atmosphere and look of the places you visit, and also act dynamically too - actually lighting up or darkening objects, characters and you! 

Maybe a slightly better looking visual style isn't the most interesting addition - but it's an important one to me so I hope you like the new look for all the buildings ingame!!


So... What can I do?
What good is this big map and fancy looking interiors without a reason to explore them!!

oath: there is a you that remains follows a similar structure to the later added parts of the base game - such as the coast and underwater areas. You aren't given a direction or objective when you start the expansion - getting up in your house and instantly able to explore the entire world to your hearts content.



So... How do you progress the story? 
Well, there is a you that remains works in a non-linear fashion. Talking to people or going to different places may unlock something new for you, or have you discover a little activity or questline. Keep on discovering new things and one by one you'll start to piece together your overall objective and goal, and find more and more along the way! 

The main objective isn't the only goal though! As you'll discover, there's multiple different things to find in game (without spoiling anything, obviously), which can lead to different side content, achievements and more. For example, the expansion has a place in game where you can change your current outfit at anytime! Find a cool shirt somewhere? You're free to put it on and play through the game wearing your new outfit. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/8be483a5811aaa73038ceb4e1c69557029f6d94b.png"]

And of course, there's plenty of small secrets and easter eggs hidden for you to find too...



The new expansion isn't insanely massive in length - probably justtt under the base game in terms of runtime, depending on whether you aim for the 100% or just story completion - but it ties into the story I wanted to tell with my new album, and I hope you enjoy it if you give it a playthrough!!


Bonus!!
And like always, there's tons of new music added into the game, from my friends and elsewhere for you to discover while playing. Along with that, there's some new music made specifically for the DLC by my friend maji*, as well as plenty music from my album and other works present as well!



I really didn't want to make the DLC paid (I'm thankful enough if you've bought the base game!!), especially since that would lock the new achievements and 100% behind a paywall - so if you enjoy and would like to support me, I just hope you check out the album side of the project as well! The whole things been in the works even since before the base game of oath was released (keen ears might recognize some of the albums music and even the albums title.. in the base game from back in the September release last year!?) and I'm really happy and excited to share what I've made.



Out on June 27th, both the album and the DLC expansion, I hope you enjoy!
Thanks for reading and playing my game if you have already, I appreciate you!! <33 



You can wishlist the DLC here!!

notes.title: oath 4.18
notes.content:
Changelog
The last foreseeable update to the game, making the entire thing more accessible to players.


Story Unlock Revamp
Up until this update, to unlock the bulk of the game, you'd need to find the secret story ending by exploring in Act II. This locked a lot of players away from a good chunk of content - and while intentional, after some thought I've made it more accessible for all to experience the full length of the game.

 Your first playthrough of the Story Mode is completely the same - you're able to unlock the secret ending on your first playthrough still, and you'll be alerted if you missed it as well like usual!
 Restarting the story for a second time will be the same up until Act II - where instead of continuing on as usual, you'll instead unlock the new content and quit to the menu.
 Restarting the story mode after this will once again play as usual!


Other QoL Changes
The major addition in this update is a brand new area, accessible after finishing the main game and parts of the epilogue! This new map doubles the size of the epilogue, with tons of secrets to find!

 The main menu has been revamped a little! the "EP player" has been moved to below story and home, as I don't deem it as important as the main content anymore - it has also been renamed to "music" to avoid confusion. 
 The angel on the main menu's wings have been adjusted - while the original placement was intentional, players commented thinking the detached wings were a bug. To alleviate this, the wings no longer seem to detach at all even when moving the camera around. 
 The main menu's music has changed, now using a different instrumental than before. This song is a lot less full on than the original, so should no longer blast your ears on first playthrough.
 The "TURN BACK" text in act 6 only displays once now. This hopefully will alleviate confusion about if you actually need to turn back or not at this section of the game.



Thank you again for all your support on my game!
I'm unsure if there will ever be another big update, DLC or sequel but I hope you enjoy the game and find all the secrets I've left in it :)
Much love!

notes.title: oath v4.17 - Diving Update
notes.content:
Changelog
The third major update to oath, including a new expansion, ending and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/ce4497c68612d3827ba54b21f20ca59119a61cac.png


Dive!
This update introduces a new mechanic, which opens up a vast new area to explore - diving! By talking to someone in the city, you might be able to get your hands on some diving equipment.... With that, you'll be able to dive down into the new deep blue patches in the ocean!

 Collect diving equipment by completing a mini quest in the Coast map!
 Once you can dive, you'll soon find out there's some secrets underwater... including a way to get into a whole new underwater city?!
 Making your way into the city, there's a multitude of quests available to you, building towards... something....
 Experience the true ending to the game by completing all of the new quests... collect all 10 new achievements too in the process!
 Diving includes brand new music by guest composers catstem and imyzuli! WIth 4 different catstem tracks playing while you explore different diving spots, and a track by imyzuli in the main city!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/ec49daf6bffe3c9d4d10593ea1d81c4e257aeb83.png


 Being underwater changes how everything looks and feels too - you'll move a bit slower while you swim around, but all your textboxes and even the entire screen will have a water-y feel!
 Explore the new city, with quests taking you all around, and even back up and down from the surface too!
 Look out for a new unlockable interior for your house as well! Give it a fitting underwater theme.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/4faa35df98306f446d1925f0fd88eb58014aaf7f.png

Graphical Overhaul
With this major update and the combined release of the physical edition, a bunch of previous areas have been given some touchups!

 The most obvious, the main menu has a new effect - instead of just the star and character moving when you move your mouse, the entire scene will move in a 3d effect!
 Along with that, once you complete the true ending, your main menu will gain a little star in the corner denoting completion! 
 All of the RPG areas from the story mode have a fresh coat of paint - giving them all slightly more detail to bring them more in line with the graphics from later in the game.
 The original Town map has also had some slight changes - added shadows in areas to make depth more apparent, especially on buildings, as well as slight building details and new zebra crossings that previously only appeared in the Coast map
 Some textures have also been fixed - with slight errors in previous builds now gone. An example of this is the zebra crossing texture now being a pure white, while before it was slightly tinted purple by accident.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/ad53d306f9880c70c761c2f60e558639f94bf91b.png

Quality of Life
A major part of this update was improving the general feel and quality of the game! There's been a lot of changes made specifically to cater towards nitpicks, small annoyances or other details which should make the game both run and feel better!

 The bottom of screen quick menu has been removed completely. Prior builds only included a few shortcuts that can be accessed with the main menu anyway, and the quick menu was causing issues when using a controller due to it being auto selected in the RPG sections. After some deliberation, the menu was removed completely due to being redundant.
 NPCs that walk around have had their hitboxes reworked! In prior builds, they would have abnormally large hitboxes that would both stop them from being able to walk into tight areas, as well as stop the player from walking past or around them. Their new hitbox allows the player to walk basically right through them, making sure they never get in your way - they will still stop if you're infront of them though so you can talk to them! (the only exception to this is a singular NPC at the coast, due to their massive hitbox being apart of their personality.)
 Places in the story mode where you would walk over a certain point and dialogue would repeat again and again, including walking left and right, now only display once, showing again if you restart the story completely. This speeds up walking around in story mode as you are no longer stopped by text you've already seen when backtracking.
 An option has been added to the menu below the controls and info - a reset button! Clicking reset will not only delete all your save files, but also all data saved by the game as well, completely wiping the game clean. This will not delete your steam achievements - however, if connected to the internet, it will also reset your data on any other devices due to cloud sync. In a similar fashion, due to oath syncing with other versions (i.e. downloaded elsewhere other than steam), resetting the game will reset any version of the game you have on hand, not just the Steam edition. Be careful!
 Game size has been reduced! The new update will reduce the games size on your PC - from ~ 2.2GB down to ~1.9GB! While a 300MB-ish reduction might not seem like too much, a reminder that this is after adding all the brand new content from this update! (As a direct comparison, removing all the new content from this update, the game would be around 1.5GB in size - that's 800MB in optimization + now another 500MB of brand new content in this update!)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/52b7ed4e7b266701a958751918bc20aa231d9c10.png

Extra
There's also a couple miscellaneous features added into this update as well: 

 2 brand new NPCs in the original town! These two are both moving NPCs, adding a bit more life into the original town that it was lacking compared to the Coast. Both NPCs also give you an indication of the Coasts existence, and how to get there!
 New main menu music! Getting sick of hearing the same track every time you open the game? Now, whenever you reboot the game, there will be new music depending on what you've accomplished! Each act in the story mode will change the music if you quit during said act, as well as each ending also having unique main menu music. Basically, whenever you change the look of the main menu, whether from a code or unlocking an ending or achievement, upon reboot you'll be greeted with a new menu track!
 20+ new cameo rooms and artists! Like previous updates, another batch of new cameos have been added, all with 3 songs and a room! All characters added in the raid update that did not have their own cameo room specifically also now have one too. The artist hallway has been updated to include all the new cameos for you to check in game! You can also see a list of all cameos in the guide section here on Steam.


Bugfixes 
There's been various bugfixes this update, including a major accidental oversight from the last update.

 If playing on a prior build, do NOT buy and customize your house before doing the raid update battle content. Due to a single line of development code being left on, customizing your house before playing the raid battles would automatically unlock the raid battle reward - the raid house interior. This would then be able to lock players out of getting the achievement for beating all the machines, due to the game thinking you had already due to having the reward unlocked. This update fixes this issue! Do note that if you have done this in a prior update, you might need to reset your game in order to get the achievement.
 Along with the graphic overhaul, the main menu has been fixed when using codes to change its appearance - due to the ordering of assets, after a certain point in game you would be unable to change the appearance of the main menu using certain codes. This fixes that, allowing swapping no matter how far into the game you are.
 Some NPCs had incorrect textboxes - using the players instead! This has been fixed.
 Some music would not play even though there was a screen notification stating a new song is playing - this is due to the song having an incorrect filename. This has now been fixed, and all ingame music should play correctly.


IMPORTANT! Please note - due to how save files and data works within the game, loading saves from prior versions of the game have the potential to not work or crash the game. Please be careful when  using old save files. Savefiles made on this version of the game, as well as autosaves, will work without issue!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108030/b2c5ccd3d00a3050966ddb8da0e13ebddf7501a0.png

Thank you for your continued support! A short sale will be running along with this updates launch as a thank you. Plus, the game is now available physically on disc! The physical edition comes with 2 CDs - the EP and game soundtrack - along with the game itself on a separate disc. You can get a copy here! The physical edition will also sync to your Steam copy - booting up the game on Steam will cause any achievements you got on the physical to auto unlock! Your progress will also carry through.
The reason behind releasing the game on disc now is because I believe with this update, the inclusion of the true ending, and all the polish and QoL changes, the game is now fully completed. I know I said similar last update, but this time I really mean it! Once again though, that doesn't mean minor updates/bugfixes or even something like a prequel or standalone expansion is out of the picture - maybe someday! Thank you again for supporting my game <3
Feel free to use the discussion tab on Steam for any questions / queries / help / bug reports, and they'll be gotten to ASAP!

As of this post, version 4.17 (internally v17.5) is the latest update.

 Version 17.4 fixes a bug within the talking section underwater, where one question has the chance of not loading correctly
 Version 17.5 fixes a bug in the artist hall where some signs would act incorrectly, including crashing the game

notes.title: oath v3.16 - re:raid Update
notes.content:
Changelog
The second major update to oath, including some tie-in content to the new vai5000 song, re:raid

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45108030/788039a087a3c467c475bf917dc8ed42ccbc56f2.png

Battle!
This update opens up a brand new building teased in the previous update - head to the top of The Coast map to find the building previously barred off is now open! Go inside to be greeted by a large room with... machines?

 The re:raid battle area includes 7 machines for you to fight and defeat!
 Figuring out how to beat all 7 nets you a brand new interior for your house as well as an achievement for your efforts!
 Each battle has a special stats that make approaching each one slightly different! A hint to each battles special traits is included with some flavor text below their stats.
 Each of the new battles includes a song by the artist that plays while you fight! Some of these artists are brand new to the game, and all returning cameos have a brand new song included.


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45108030/4775853c108eefaa5c4344329f6a0b14ccbfea5a.png


 Certain battles will reward you with healing items you can use to strategize with! Enemy attack power uses a varied algorithm so that no two attempts at a fight are the same - collect a healing item to turn the tide in your favor?
 The defend mechanic is a high risk high reward system - generally speaking defending from an attack will reduce the damage taken to a minimal level, letting you survive a strong attack! However, sometimes your defense will fail and you'll take double the damage! Conversely, you might even heal some damage while defending... Be careful using it!
 A version of re:raid that is longer than the version as of writing on streaming platforms is also available to listen to in game! It might be helpful to your battles too....


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45108030/4bc676021614954c1cfddb6ad9e9094ab18309b3.png

Playable Cameos
Every single artist featuring on the new single, re:raid is now playable in game! 

 All 9 featured artists, across all variations of the track are now able to be used as a playable skin to playthrough the RPG sections of the game!
 Joining the vai5000 skin, inputting the name of any of the featured artists as your own name in the story mode will switch your skin to that artist until story mode is restarted!
 You can check what artist you are playing as by the small icon on the main menu with your current skin.
 Skins work both in the story mode RPG sections as well as the Epilogue - Including both the City and Coast maps! Note you will not be able to enter the re:raid battle arena while playing as an alternate skin
 A new karaoke song is available! Playing as one of the new cameo skins will allow you to sing a brand new song at the karaoke bar... including some familiar sounds and graphics! 
 A tenth special playable skin is also included.... Unlocked by a secret code...


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45108030/78f735542391f585d67ba114a836cad56c8359f1.png

List of playable skins:
(As of update 3.14 - More playable skins have the potential to be added in the future.)

 vai5000
 swazy*
 rubyred
 crusafix
 aftrr
 tsuyunoshi
 zayok
 crusey
 8tsukii
 nujioh
 Kazuma Kiryu (City only. Access to special events and locations.)


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45108030/e8b72a608b4e6bd4283f5b3fb96092b720729cb1.png

Game Soundtrack
As you might've seen, the in game soundtrack is now available on Steam!

 This soundtrack includes songs created specifically for the game, not including any cameo music or full releases. 
 The soundtrack is a standalone addition to your library! Using Steams integrated soundtrack system, you can play the soundtrack directly from/in Steam. You also do not need to own the game to download the soundtrack!

Available Here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3235100/oath_Soundtrack/

Bugfixes and QoL
Various bugfixes have been made that fix multiple issues introduced within the last major update.

 Game crashing on entering the new area very rarely has now been fixed
 Loading a save into the eimi demo map and going to the bottom right will no longer crash the game
 The NPCs in the hotel now have their correct dialogue. An upstairs NPC was incorrectly labeled with repeated dialogue, and a downstairs NPC did not have any unique dialogue
 Numerous clipping issues have been fixed. Areas that look solid but allowed the player to walk through them unintentionally have been removed, including near the cafe and the train tracks near the vinyl. 
 However, the out of bounds glitch in the subway has been kept - doing this now has an expanded intentional area.
 Multiple signs in artist cameo rooms have been fixed to not crash the game or display the wrong text.
 Multiple songs in cameo rooms now have corrected notification text
 Added credits and controls pages to the settings menu! Accessible from the settings menu at any time, you can now view the game controls as well as the credits / information page!
 We've updated the storepage too! It now reflects the latest updates and delves deeper into the game as a whole - plus it now has animations!


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45108030/742177562d89e563d8138f5f0170f565ca86e913.png

Thank you again for your support!  To celebrate the release of this update, plus just over a month since launch, a weeklong sale for the game will start October 14th! This update marks the last major planned update - there are currently no plans for future updates outside of bugfixes, but there is still the potential that I'll add brand new updates - both small and large - in the future if there's anything cool I would like to add! If I have the time for it, a full on story expansion / prequel isn't out of the picture, but it might be a while before this update ever comes to fruition... Keep an eye out!
Feel free to use the discussion tab on Steam for any questions / queries / help / bug reports, and they'll be gotten to ASAP!

As of this post, version 3.16 (internally v16.6) is the latest update.

notes.title: oath v2.12 - Major Update 1
notes.content:
Changelog
The first major update for oath, including a brand new expansion to the epilogue

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45108030/b02e8b2f9abeb63fcfe1f619e8580c05666b8199.png

To the Coast!
The major addition in this update is a brand new area, accessible after finishing the main game and parts of the epilogue! This new map doubles the size of the epilogue, with tons of secrets to find!

 Access the new map by interacting with the taxi once you've explored the epilogue a bit! More lively than ever, meet NPCs that move around the map, have quests for you, and interact with the current time of day!
 The new Coast map is a lot more vertical, with 3 tiers to its world - a vast beach at the bottom, and elevated buildings near the top
 Multiple new buildings you can enter, with events, secrets and more


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45108030/6a6378cc9a5a2c392e8946ff9dacda0134ab4eeb.png


 Theatre: go to the theatre to watch the music video for suffocate, from the EP + more!
 Your House: Follow one of the new questlines to gain access to a new place to call home! You can customize your new house with multiple different interior styles, which you can unlock around the map! Go explore to find them all....
 Cafe: Check out the cafe! It's only open from 9 am to 5 pm, and not on Sunday though...


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45108030/146b1228d17f6c6ee5301ad185b081724ccb8496.png

More Cameos...
Found all the artist cameos? There's a lot! Well- now there's even more to find! All 20-ish new rooms are accessible from the get-go, but there's a new artist hall to make your life easier as well!

 20ish new cameos! None of these count towards the 'oracle' achievement - only the artists present in the artist hall do
 Once you find all the artist hall artists (and unlock the oracle achievement), you'll gain access to a new artist hall containing all the new cameos! 
 The artist hall signs now tell you if you've visited a room before - perfect for keeping track of which artists you need for the achievement! There's also a sign at the end of the hall that will help you with your progress


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45108030/217db30c2174bb58cd639edee04aa83c16540784.png

Plus more!
Multiple quality of life improvements, plus extras have been added!

 New playable character skin: you can now play as vai5000 by inputting that as your name! You can play through all the RPG sections with this skin. (Please note, while this skin can access the new area, the other secret playable skin cannot. It can however access areas unique to it.)
 Main Menu Quality of Life: along with a few new secret main menu versions, accessible by inputting your name as various things, a little sprite of your currently selected player skin is now in the bottom left corner. This now makes it easier to tell if you're using a skin, and which one! This will be even more helpful later down the line with more potential playable skins in later updates...
 6 new achievements: there's 6 brand new achievements to find! All achievements are related to the new Coast area, with some being easy to find (visit the new area), while others will require you to really search around and collect things you find!


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45108030/e7d19411798ff48377e21e9c376f37c41d9ab206.png


 Sound Adjustment: various in game sounds have been slightly edited so that they are levelled better. Less sound effect jumpscares now! You can also modify the volume of music and sound effects separately in the settings menu
 More demo compatibility: some players realized that due to how the eimi demo (a standalone completely unique area, check it out if you haven't!) communicates to the main game, created saves in the demo allow you to access the special demo map while playing oath. Originally, doing this would result in crashes and other issues - but now there's unique dialogue for doing this! The game will no longer crash when you load any saves from the demo, and will actively scold you for doing so.
 Quest Autosave: many variables in-game save automatically, regardless of whether you use a save file. This allows them to persist across multiple saves, Story and Home, and be used to customize things such as the main menu. This functionality also makes its way into the new quest in the Coast - doing parts of the quest will permanently unlock their corresponding features, and even if you do not save your progress with a save state, your quest progress will be remembered.


Bugfixes
Tons of small bugs and other details have been fixed in this (and some previous) updates!

 Hitboxes have been modified in some areas allowing tiles that should be walkable to now be actually walkable
 Music playback in some of the secret artist rooms were incorrectly assigned, this has now been fixed
 Music playback from vending machines in the epilogue was broken before this update - their original functionality has now been restored! Once you've gotten the oracle achievement, interacting with vending machines across the map more than once will switch the maps music to a song from a member of the music scene.
 Some users reported crashes that logged missing labels when talking to a cameo artist. This issue has been determined to be from an older build, and is fixed in this current update
 Static areas such as elevators and trains would show the default player skin when riding them. These have been updated to include custom graphics depending on the player character
 Moving NPCs have 2 known 'issues' - some might note that their hitboxes can sometimes be a bit odd/large. They're just big boned. A solve for these hitboxes is being worked on, but for the time being just move out of their way. Another NPC is also able to potentially corner you and pin you down, fundamentally resulting in a softlock. This is a feature - if softlocked, please return to the menu. Your quest progress is automatically saved regardless of using the save function


Thank you so much for the support on oath! Keep an eye out for more new updates down the line, including minor updates + at least one more major update coming mid October to coincide with another special release... 
Feel free to use the discussion tab on Steam for any questions / queries / help / bug reports, and they'll be gotten to ASAP!

As of this post, version 2.13 (internally v12.2) is the latest update. This small patch includes a vital bugfix that would stop players from being able to access new content. Please check your game is up to date before launching.
